headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended winning streak to 4 weeks as indices hit 9-month highs

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Indian stock market extended its winning streak to 4 consecutive weeks with indices gaining around 3%.
Record foreign institutional investor (FII) buying pushed Sensex and Nifty to 9-month highs.
Banking, auto, and IT stocks supported market recovery from mid-week dips.
Global cues such as US Fed rate hike signals and an AI stock selloff caused brief pressure earlier in the week.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 logged 3% weekly gains to close out a strong four-week rally.
Markets experienced mid-week volatility with Sensex surging nearly 1,000 points led by auto and bank stocks.
Banking and IT stocks supported recovery during intraday trade on November 20.
The Centre has filed for a review after Yes Bank AT-1 bondholders won their case in the Supreme Court.
summary: Indian benchmark indices extended their winning streak to four straight weeks, with Sensex and Nifty touching 9-month highs powered by strong FII buying. Despite global pressure from Fed rate signals and AI selloffs, strong buying in banking, auto, and IT stocks sustained the rally. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, 23 November.
